questions.text: Match each traveller with a suitable notice.
questions.explanation: 1) A passenger wants to check in before an early international flight. — Завчасна онлайн-реєстрація перед авіарейсом. Фрагмент: AIRPORT: Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure; please keep travel documents ready. 2) A visitor needs step-free access to a museum. — Оголошення описує безбар'єрний вхід і ліфт. Фрагмент: MUSEUM ACCESS: A lift is available beside the main entrance; ask staff for assistance if required. 3) A hiker wants to avoid a closed mountain path. — Попередження повідомляє про закритий маршрут і обхід. Фрагмент: TRAIL ALERT: The northern route is temporarily shut due to fallen trees. Use the marked southern trail. 4) A tourist wishes to travel between towns without a car. — Залізниця дає міжміське сполучення без автомобіля. Фрагмент: REGIONAL RAIL: Trains leave every two hours and tickets can be purchased through the mobile application.

pairs: A passenger wants to check in before an early international flight.
AIRPORT: Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure; please keep travel documents ready.
A visitor needs step-free access to a museum.
MUSEUM ACCESS: A lift is available beside the main entrance; ask staff for assistance if required.
A hiker wants to avoid a closed mountain path.
TRAIL ALERT: The northern route is temporarily shut due to fallen trees. Use the marked southern trail.
A tourist wishes to travel between towns without a car.
REGIONAL RAIL: Trains leave every two hours and tickets can be purchased through the mobile application.

questions.text: Match the headings with the environmental paragraphs.
questions.explanation: 1) Protecting a local river — Очищення берегів та запобігання потраплянню пластику. Фрагмент: Volunteers collected plastic waste along the banks. They also asked nearby shops to reduce unnecessary packaging. 2) Using less energy at home — Домашня економія енергії. Фрагмент: The family replaced old bulbs with efficient lighting. They also switched off electrical appliances when not needed. 3) Rebuilding natural habitats — Відновлення місць існування диких тварин. Фрагмент: A damaged wetland was restored with native plants. Birds began nesting there again after several seasons. 4) Travelling with a smaller footprint — Відповідальні туристичні рішення з меншим впливом. Фрагмент: During their holiday, the students used buses and stayed in locally owned guesthouses. They avoided unnecessary flights.

pairs: Protecting a local river
Volunteers collected plastic waste along the banks. They also asked nearby shops to reduce unnecessary packaging.
Using less energy at home
The family replaced old bulbs with efficient lighting. They also switched off electrical appliances when not needed.
Rebuilding natural habitats
A damaged wetland was restored with native plants. Birds began nesting there again after several seasons.
Travelling with a smaller footprint
During their holiday, the students used buses and stayed in locally owned guesthouses. They avoided unnecessary flights.

questions.text: Match each environmental word with its definition.
questions.explanation: 1) habitat — Habitat — природне середовище існування виду. Фрагмент: The natural surroundings in which a plant or animal lives. 2) biodiversity — Biodiversity — різноманіття живих організмів. Фрагмент: The variety of living organisms within an area or ecosystem. 3) erosion — Erosion — руйнування або змивання ґрунту й порід. Фрагмент: The gradual wearing away of soil or rock by water, wind or other processes. 4) conservation — Conservation — охорона та ощадне використання природи. Фрагмент: The protection and careful management of natural resources.

pairs: habitat
The natural surroundings in which a plant or animal lives.
biodiversity
The variety of living organisms within an area or ecosystem.
erosion
The gradual wearing away of soil or rock by water, wind or other processes.
conservation
The protection and careful management of natural resources.

questions.text: Match each transport term to its meaning.
questions.explanation: 1) connection — Connection — пересадка або стикування рейсів. Фрагмент: A second service you need to catch to continue a journey. 2) delay — Delay — запізнення транспорту. Фрагмент: A period by which a service departs or arrives later than planned. 3) itinerary — Itinerary — детальний маршрут подорожі. Фрагмент: A planned sequence of destinations and activities during a trip. 4) fare — Fare — вартість проїзду. Фрагмент: The amount paid for a journey on public transport.

pairs: connection
A second service you need to catch to continue a journey.
delay
A period by which a service departs or arrives later than planned.
itinerary
A planned sequence of destinations and activities during a trip.
fare
The amount paid for a journey on public transport.

questions.text: Match the start of each travel advice sentence with the ending.
questions.explanation: 1) If you are travelling during the busy season, — Популярний сезон потребує раннього бронювання. Фрагмент: book accommodation well in advance. 2) Before you enter a protected nature reserve, — Заповідні території мають правила відвідування. Фрагмент: read the local rules and stay on marked paths. 3) When public transport is disrupted, — У разі збою руху варто перевірити офіційні повідомлення. Фрагмент: check the operator's updates for alternative routes. 4) To reduce unnecessary waste while sightseeing, — Багаторазова пляшка зменшує використання одноразової тари. Фрагмент: carry a refillable bottle instead of buying disposable ones.

pairs: If you are travelling during the busy season,
book accommodation well in advance.
Before you enter a protected nature reserve,
read the local rules and stay on marked paths.
When public transport is disrupted,
check the operator's updates for alternative routes.
To reduce unnecessary waste while sightseeing,
carry a refillable bottle instead of buying disposable ones.

questions.text: Match each climate-related term with a practical example.
questions.explanation: 1) adaptation — Adaptation — пристосування до наслідків змін клімату. Фрагмент: A coastal town raises flood barriers to cope with higher sea levels. 2) mitigation — Mitigation — скорочення причин змін клімату. Фрагмент: A city replaces diesel buses with electric vehicles to lower emissions. 3) resilience — Resilience — здатність відновитися після порушень. Фрагмент: A community restores essential services quickly after severe weather. 4) carbon footprint — Carbon footprint — сукупні викиди, пов'язані з діяльністю. Фрагмент: A company calculates greenhouse gases linked to its activities.

pairs: adaptation
A coastal town raises flood barriers to cope with higher sea levels.
mitigation
A city replaces diesel buses with electric vehicles to lower emissions.
resilience
A community restores essential services quickly after severe weather.
carbon footprint
A company calculates greenhouse gases linked to its activities.

questions.text: Match the headings with the paragraphs about responsible tourism.
questions.explanation: 1) Pressure on local services — Текст описує перевантаження інфраструктури туристами. Фрагмент: A small coastal town receives far more visitors than its public transport can handle in summer. Residents struggle to reach work during peak hours. 2) Benefits for small businesses — Гроші туристів підтримують місцеву економіку. Фрагмент: Visitors choose family-run cafés and buy products from local craftspeople. More of their spending stays within the community. 3) Limiting harm to wildlife — Йдеться про захист поведінки тварин під час екскурсій. Фрагмент: A nature guide asks guests to observe animals from a distance. Feeding them is not allowed because it changes their behaviour. 4) Learning from local people — Культурний обмін через участь у заняттях. Фрагмент: Travellers join workshops run by residents rather than taking photographs from outside. They gain a deeper understanding of regional traditions.

pairs: Pressure on local services
A small coastal town receives far more visitors than its public transport can handle in summer. Residents struggle to reach work during peak hours.
Benefits for small businesses
Visitors choose family-run cafés and buy products from local craftspeople. More of their spending stays within the community.
Limiting harm to wildlife
A nature guide asks guests to observe animals from a distance. Feeding them is not allowed because it changes their behaviour.
Learning from local people
Travellers join workshops run by residents rather than taking photographs from outside. They gain a deeper understanding of regional traditions.

questions.text: Match the cause with the most plausible environmental consequence.
questions.explanation: 1) Large areas of forest are removed from steep hillsides. — Вирубування лісів підсилює ерозію ґрунтів. Фрагмент: Heavy rain washes exposed soil into nearby rivers. 2) Fertilisers enter a lake in unusually high quantities. — Надлишок поживних речовин спричиняє евтрофікацію. Фрагмент: Rapid algal growth reduces oxygen available to aquatic life. 3) A long period passes with very little rainfall. — Тривала посуха погіршує доступність води та врожаї. Фрагмент: Farmers face water shortages and declining crop yields. 4) An invasive species spreads without natural predators. — Інвазійний вид витісняє місцеві популяції. Фрагмент: Native populations decline as competition for resources increases.

pairs: Large areas of forest are removed from steep hillsides.
Heavy rain washes exposed soil into nearby rivers.
Fertilisers enter a lake in unusually high quantities.
Rapid algal growth reduces oxygen available to aquatic life.
A long period passes with very little rainfall.
Farmers face water shortages and declining crop yields.
An invasive species spreads without natural predators.
Native populations decline as competition for resources increases.
